whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Royal Rasoi Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has been serving Patna from Fraser Road for years, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table bookings and online food orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table reservation, aur signature dishes integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/royalrasoi

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Royal Rasoi Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Royal Rasoi Restaurant on Fraser Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering, table reservations, and a mobile-first showcase of your dining experience right in the heart of Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
